newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Verilink estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Verilink estimates cut.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said its analyst Joe Noel cut his earnings and revenue estimates for Verilink after the company pre-announced a March quarter earnings shortfall.
-- Noel said Verilink appears to be seeing lower than expected sales of personal communications services products.

-- He cut the fiscal 1997 earnings estimate to $0.35/shr on sales of $59.1 million from a previous $0.49/shr on $66.2 million in sales. His March quarter (Q3) estimate went to $0.06/shr on sales of $14.0 million from $0.13/shr and $17.1 million, respectively. His Q4 estimates fell to a net profit of $0.07/shr on sales of $14.1 million from $0.14 and $18.1, respectively.
